question: 'Chikara' is a ______ musical instrument popular in the state of Madhya Pradesh
solution:
The correct answer is __Stringed__.

__
 
• Chikara is a stringed musical instrument popular in the state of Madhya Pradesh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Chikara is a stringed instrument made of parchment, wood, and steel.
 
• It is a** local instrument** found in **Madhya Pradesh and Rajasthan.**
 
• It is majorly used by the Pradhan community for vocal accompaniment to songs and dance sequences in Madhya Pradesh.
 
• Moreover, it is used by the Meo community of the Alwar district of Rajasthan for vocal accompaniment.
 
• **Folk Music Instruments from Madhya Pradesh are:**__
 __
 
• **Goga Dhol.**
 
• **Parang drum.**
 
• **Ghera.**
 
• **Pawli.**
